realExecution.machineDescription: single arm64 development Mac, developer account -- no other machine, macOS version, or user account has run this migration

knownGaps: Planned scenario 8 (disk full mid-copy) has no dedicated test; the temp-then-rename invariant it relies on is covered by scenario 7.

Planned scenario 13 (post-migration launch through a real AppEnvironment) is covered only by a path-contract assertion, because AppEnvironment.shared is a process-wide singleton over the real ~/Library that no test may touch.
Planned scenario 15 (Gatekeeper first-launch behaviour after the bundle-ID change) remains BLOCKED_ENVIRONMENT: the build is unsigned and not notarized.
The one real run took the happy path. Skip, failure, rollback and interrupted-resume paths are exercised only by unit tests against temporary directories.
